description: Bus Stops in Perth & Kinross is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. Bus stop locations in Perth and Kinross. The bus stop data is collected by Perth and Kinross Council and shared with the Department of Transport as part of the national public transport access nodes. Coverage: Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. The portal files it under the publisher Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. Its tags are Bus Stop, Transport, Transport networks. The portal shows 2024-06-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
